end.summary:
Practised identifying points, line segments, lines and rays by endpoints and arrows.
Aryan gave 5 unaided correct responses out of 7 attempts.
They identified rays as having one endpoint and segments as having two fixed endpoints.
They initially called a 12 cm drawing a longer line; this mix-up was not marked corrected after the last seen instance.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Aryan practised telling points, line segments, lines and rays apart using endpoints, arrows, and direction. They explained ray examples using a torch beam and identified segment drawings from their two fixed endpoints. The line-length mix-up appeared when they called a 12 cm drawing a longer line; it was not marked corrected after the last instance. At home, ask them to compare two line drawings and explain why the measured drawing length is not the length of the complete line.
